summary: Brother of Giuseppina Fiorillo, born in San Mango d'Aquino in 1886, who married Maria Mendicino there in 1909.
bio: Gaetano Fiorillo was born in 1886 in San Mango d'Aquino, a brother of Giuseppina Fiorillo. On 13 May 1909 he married Maria Mendicino, daughter of Tommaso Mendicino and Raffaela Ianni, at San Mango.
